与家庭生活一起成长(Growing up with family life): 一篇关于家庭生活的B1记叙文:汤姆的经历、感受与成长。

Little by little, things began to change. Tom is saving money to buy a ticket to Paris. Tom plans to study music harder this term. The palace ballroom has gilded ceilings and huge crystal chandeliers.
At first, Tom found it difficult to keep the habit. Tom's dream job is to be a nurse. On Tuesday evenings, Tom reviews the notes from class. The small hall can accommodate two hundred people.

The old photo album has become an important part of daily life. People around Tom often share different ideas about the balcony. There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. We have breakfast on the terrace.

The balcony looked quieter than usual that evening. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Tom wrote down every idea in a small notebook. In fact, the farmers drove a stake into the soft ground.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Tom more than any book could. Owen always says that small steps matter more than big plans.
